title: Size Generalization for Diffusion Routing Solvers
abstract: arXiv:2610.17192v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Routing problems, like the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), are NP-hard and slow to solve for large instances. Diffusion-based solvers can be trained in a supervised way using sets of optimal solutions, and then quickly solve new test instances. However, for large instances, optimal solutions are hard to find, and diffusion models fail to generalize to instance sizes outside their training distribution. Here we describe ResizeCO, a label free size-generalization approach that addresses both the change in statistical properties of larger instances, and the computational challenge of solving them quickly. It uses reinforcement learning on large-scale instances to adapt a diffusion model trained on small instances. Specifically, we adapt GRPO to this problem, using route length as the training signal. ResizeCO also formulates k-opt as a tree search, solved by a beam search on the GPU. In s

translated_title: 扩散模型路由求解器的尺寸泛化
translated_abstract: 路由问题，如旅行商问题（TSP）和带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP），属于NP难问题，在大规模实例上求解速度很慢。基于扩散的求解器可以利用最优解集合以监督方式训练，然后快速求解新的测试实例。然而，对于大规模实例，最优解难以获得，且扩散模型无法泛化到训练分布之外的实例尺寸。本文提出了ResizeCO，一种无需标签的尺寸泛化方法，同时解决了大规模实例统计特性变化的问题以及快速求解的计算挑战。该方法使用强化学习在大规模实例上对基于小实例训练的扩散模型进行调整。具体而言，我们将GRPO适配到该问题中，使用路径长度作为训练信号。ResizeCO还将k-opt操作形式化为树搜索问题，通过GPU上的束搜索进行求解。
tldr: 提出了一种无需标签的尺寸泛化方法ResizeCO，通过基于GRPO的强化学习（以路径长度为训练信号）和GPU上的k-opt树搜索，使扩散模型路由求解器能够泛化到训练分布之外的大规模TSP和CVRP实例。
en_tdlr: ResizeCO, a label-free size-generalization approach, enables diffusion routing solvers to generalize to larger TSP and CVRP instances beyond their training distribution by adapting GRPO-based reinforcement learning with route length as the training signal and formulating k-opt as a GPU-based beam search tree search.
